syllabus: Unit 5 has に (time), 〜から〜まで, 〜前に, 〜後で, 〜てから, 〜とき, 〜ながら, 〜たり〜たりする, もう and まだ: a fair N5 set in a sensible order, and since it uses te-, dictionary- and ta-forms as fixed shapes before units 6 and 7 teach them, should units 5 and 6 swap?

n5u05d1.p1: The rule rows say 〜よう日 takes に. In speech に is often dropped (日よう日、友だちと会います). Is the rule overstated?
n5u05d1.d5: Star item. The tiles split 七時 and 半 (七時半におきます). Fair, or should 七時半 be one tile?
n5u05d1.e2: Answer まで (B: よる九時までです). から is wrong only by B's reply, and 何時にですか sounds odd. Both clearly wrong?
n5u05d1.e3: Star item. Please confirm あしたのテストからは何時ですか is clearly wrong.
n5u05d1.k: Bank-door scene. Day 1 also uses はたらきます, プール, テスト and よる. All fair N5 words?
n5u05d1.k1: The wrong readings ごこ and ごうご are made up. Several items in this unit use made-up forms (あらいてから, しますてから, 聞きたり, まいしゅ). Acceptable as distractors?
n5u05d1.r1: Quick response. 八時間です (a length of time) may be too easy to rule out. Fine?
n5u05d2.d1: Answer 前に. 前で is wrong only on meaning. Clearly wrong?
n5u05d2.d2: Answer 後で. Please confirm 来たまで is clearly wrong.
n5u05d2.d5: Star item. Please confirm 日本へ日本語の本を来る前に買いました is clearly wrong.
n5u05d2.d6: Stars d6 and e3 seem easy (only one sensible order). Fine for N5?
n5u05d2.e2: Tests the same thing as d4 (た-form before 後で, same four options). Too close?
n5u05d2.k: Medicine-bag scene keeps 食前 and 食後 (above N5). Day 2 also uses しゅくだい, じゅぎょう, しんぶん, シャワーをあびる, はをみがく, おふろに入る, 一ぱい, ばんごはん. Fair?
n5u05d2.k1: Rewritten after the check (この　くすりは　毎日　飲みます). Please read once.
n5u05d3.d2: Answer してから. するから ('because I do') is grammatical and wrong only on meaning. Clearly wrong here?
n5u05d3.d5: Stars d5 and e3 (〜てから, から on its own tile) seem easy. Fine?
n5u05d3.k: Library scene. Day 3 also uses あびる, スーパー, かえす, 新聞, はじめに and the name 川口. All fair for N5?
n5u05d4.p2: The watch note marks 本を読んだり、テレビを見ます as wrong. A single たり is heard in speech. Fair as the ✕ example?
n5u05d4.d1: Answer 聞きながら. 聞いてながら may sound like casual 聞いていながら. Clearly wrong?
n5u05d4.d6: Star item (山へ行ったり、友だちのうちであそんだりします). Natural?
n5u05d4.k: Leaflet scene. Day 4 also uses ちらし, はしります, きっさてん, 本や, せんたく, あらいます. All fair N5 words?
n5u05d5.d4: Answer まだ (train at nine, now eight). Is もう時間がありますね clearly wrong?
n5u05d5.e2: Answer もう. Please confirm まだいません is clearly wrong after 五時にかえりました.
n5u05d5.e3: Star item. B's line (つめたいジュースはもうありませんよ) works only if B is the host. Clear enough?
n5u05d5.k: Station board: real boards write 発, not 出ました. Day 5 also uses あんパン, あと五分, これから, おかし, りょこう, ふくを入れる. Fair?
n5u05d5.r1: The narrator says 話しています (ている comes in unit 6). Fine as a set phrase here?
n5u05d6.d3: Answer まで／もう. It relies on reading よるの八時 as after closing (seven). Clear enough?
n5u05d6.d4: Answer とき／ながら. Option 3 (テレビを見たりアイスを食べます) has a single たり, heard in casual speech. Clearly wrong?
n5u05d6.d6: Rewritten after the check (まだです moved out of the tiles). Please read once.
n5u05d6.e1: Answer まだです. もうありません is a weak wrong option. Fine?
n5u05d6.e3: Star item (しごとの後で六時から八時まで). Too easy?
n5u05d6.k: Whiteboard scene. Day 6 also uses アイス, できません, ホワイトボード, ひるごはん. All fair N5 words?
n5u05t.5: Answer ひる. ばん is wrong only if 十二時 is read as noon. Clear enough with おなかがすきました?
n5u05t.13: Answer から. Please confirm かけてまで is clearly wrong.
n5u05t.14: Uses のぼる; the test also has ひる休み and さんぽ. All N5 words?
n5u05t.16: Stars 16 and 18 seem easy for a test. Fine?
n5u05t.22: Rewritten after the check (no option on the 三時 boundary; answer 午後三時半). Please read once.
